reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the move, but writes its own daily-weekend skip instead of having one shared 'final day of an occurrence' function that getNextDate also uses.

duplication.why: The `skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily' && isWeekend` skip restates the rule getNextDate already encodes inline (skipsDailyWeekends), and the schedule-building and skipWeekend-ternary skeleton mirrors getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way, though the date-resolution rule would belong in shared/schedules.ts with getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: The weekend rule now has a third, independently written variant (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange), so a rule change must find each one; the hard-coded ±3 day window is an unexplained coupling to the weekend length.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared helper for the daily-skip rule exists in the tree; the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend is used for moving.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange's flatMap guard re-expresses getNextDate's skipsDailyWeekends filter (shared/schedules.ts) as a per-occurrence early return rather than sharing it.
